title: Invoice self-service
body:
**Goal:** Enable residential customers to independently find, view, and download their recent invoices in the customer portal.

**Benefit:** Customers can obtain invoice copies without contacting support; support demand for invoice copies is expected to decrease.

**Owner:** Jane Doe, Product Owner, Billing Platform team.

**Stakeholders:** Customer Support, Billing Operations, Finance.

**Success Measure:** Validate whether invoice-copy contacts decrease after release; the target and measurement baseline must be agreed with the product team before use.

**In Scope:** Invoice overview, invoice details, and PDF download for invoices that are already available in the billing system.

**Out of Scope:** Creating invoices, payment collection, dunning, changing billing addresses, and invoices not available from the billing system.

**Candidate Stories:**
- Download an existing invoice as PDF
- View the invoice overview
- See an empty-state message when no invoice is available

title: Download invoice as PDF
body:
**Story:** As a residential customer, I want to download an existing invoice as a PDF so that I can store it for my accounting.

**Context:** Self-Service Customer Portal, residential customers, part of Epic #1.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in and have at least one invoice, when I select "Download PDF", then the download starts within 3 seconds.
- [ ] Given I have no invoice, when I open the invoices page, then I see "No invoices available".
- [ ] Given the PDF is generated, when I open it, then it contains the invoice number, date, total amount, and my customer number.
- [ ] Given I am not signed in, when I access an invoice URL, then I am redirected to the sign-in page.

title: Reset password
body:
**Story:** As a customer, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access if I forget it.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am on the login page, when I click "Forgot password", then I receive an email with a reset link.
- [ ] Given I click the reset link, when I enter a new password, then I can log in with the new password.
- [ ] Given the link is older than 24 hours, when I click it, then I see an error message.

title: Manage account settings
body:
**Story:** As a customer, I want to manage my profile, notification preferences, payment method, and security settings so that my account is up to date.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in, when I open account settings, then I see all options.
- [ ] Given I change a setting, when I save, then the change is applied.

body: The customer portal should be modern and better.

title: View invoice overview
body:
**Story:** As a residential customer, I want to view a list of my available invoices so that I can see what I owe.

**Context:** Self-Service Customer Portal, residential customers, part of Epic #1.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in, when I open the invoices page, then I see a list of my invoices sorted by date descending.
- [ ] Given I have no invoices, when I open the page, then I see "No invoices available".
- [ ] Given I select an invoice, when I click it, then I see the invoice details.

title: Change payment method
body:
**Story:** As a customer, I want to change my payment method so that I can pay with a different card.

**Context:** Self-Service Customer Portal.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in, when I open payment settings, then I see my current payment method.
- [ ] Given I add a new card, when I save, then the new card is used for future invoices.
- [ ] Given the card is invalid, when I try to save, then I see an error message.

title: Database migration to PostgreSQL 16
body:
**Task:** Migrate the billing database from PostgreSQL 14 to PostgreSQL 16.

**Technical Scope:**
- Upgrade the billing database cluster to PostgreSQL 16
- Migrate schema and data with pg_upgrade
- Update the connection settings of the billing API

**Justification:** PostgreSQL 14 reaches end of life in November 2026. After that date no security patches are published, which is a compliance risk for payment data.

**Impact:** Affected systems: billing API and invoice export job. Planned downtime: 30 minutes in the Sunday maintenance window. Risk: incompatible custom extensions. Teams: Backend, DevOps.

**Rollback Plan:**
1. Stop the billing API.
2. Restore the backup taken before the migration.
3. Restart the API and verify an invoice export.
The procedure was tested in staging and takes about 15 minutes. Runbook: wiki page "DB migration".

**Verification:**
- [ ] Given the migration is complete, when the invoice export runs, then all invoices of the last 12 months are returned.
- [ ] Given the migration fails in staging, when the rollback procedure is executed, then the billing API is available again within 15 minutes.

title: Modernize infrastructure
body:
**Task:** Migrate all services to Kubernetes, update all databases, and implement a service mesh.

**Justification:** The current virtual machines reach end of life in 2027 and have open security findings.

**Technical Scope:**
- Migrate all services to Kubernetes
- Update all databases to the current major version
- Implement a service mesh for all service-to-service traffic

**Rollback Plan:** Keep the old virtual machines running in parallel until every service is verified. The restore from backup was tested in staging and takes about 2 hours.

**Verification:**
- [ ] Given all services run on Kubernetes, when the smoke tests run, then all tests pass.
- [ ] Given a service fails after the migration, when the rollback is triggered, then traffic returns to the old virtual machines.

title: PDF download fails on mobile Safari (iOS 16)
body:
**Bug:** The PDF download of an invoice fails on mobile Safari.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Sign in to the customer portal on an iPhone.
2. Open the invoices page and select the latest invoice.
3. Tap "Download PDF".

**Expected:** The PDF download starts within 3 seconds.
**Actual:** The message "Download failed" appears and no file is saved.

**Environment:** iPhone 13, iOS 16.5, Safari 16.5

**Severity:** Major – customers cannot download invoices on iPhones and there is no workaround in the app.

**Reproducibility:** Always – it occurs on every attempt with the steps above.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Given I am signed in on mobile Safari, when I tap "Download PDF", then the download starts within 3 seconds.
- [ ] Given the invoice has no PDF, when I tap "Download PDF", then I see the message "PDF not available".

title: Intermittent login failures across all platforms
body:
**Bug:** Users sometimes cannot log in on web, iOS, and Android.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Open the login page.
2. Enter valid credentials and tap "Sign In".

**Expected:** The user is signed in and sees the dashboard.
**Actual:** The login fails with a generic error. The cause may be the authentication service, session management, or one of the clients.

**Environment:** Chrome 118, iOS 17.1, Android 14

**Severity:** Major – affected users cannot use the portal.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Given valid credentials, when I sign in on web, iOS or Android, then I reach the dashboard within 3 seconds.
- [ ] Given invalid credentials, when I sign in, then I see the message "Invalid credentials".
